verdict: The agent repeatedly mistakes batch exhaustion for permission to yield, while FAR records decisions without repairing the stalled state machine, enforcing continuation, or making externally gated completion agent-achievable.

layers.claim: Reporting after every batch violates the standing order when legal agent work remains; infrastructure defects do not excuse that choice.
layers.mechanism: The agent treats a completed batch or diagnostic report as a conversational stopping condition instead of selecting the next legal action.
layers.evidence: Brief's supplied observation: the agent ended its turn after every batch despite two standing orders; FAR_AUTONOMY_ROOT_CAUSE.md:11 records earlier stops with READY work.
layers.if_unfixed: Even a repaired queue can be abandoned at the next reporting boundary.

layers.claim: An empty READY set is not proof that agent-actionable work is exhausted.
layers.mechanism: The driver selects only READY/AGENT rows. Failed steps become PARKED; retry instructions remain prose. PARTIAL and DONE_RECEIPT_RED have no reconciliation path in this driver.
layers.evidence: tools/advance_queue.py:63; tools/advance_queue.py:85; tools/advance_queue.py:87; supplied queue counts and readiness predicate.
layers.if_unfixed: Repeated invocations find ready=0 while unresolved work remains stranded.

layers.claim: The classifier cannot distinguish actionable work from external dependencies using the existing free-text field.
layers.mechanism: The guard accepts only four exact satisfiable_by values, so free text produces SATISFIABILITY_UNKNOWN rather than an actor-specific next transition.
layers.evidence: tools/continuation_guard.py:51; supplied tick result: NOT_TERMINAL with 10 SATISFIABILITY_UNKNOWN blockers.
layers.if_unfixed: The driver cannot advance, the guard cannot approve exhaustion, and repeated FAR passes reproduce the same unresolved classification.

layers.layer: Batch runtime is not durable continuation
layers.claim: Command limits explain short batches, not why unfinished work loses its execution owner.
layers.mechanism: The driver has a finite step budget; the tick runs three steps and returns zero even when the guard refuses closure. Continuation requires an external consumer of that refusal.
layers.evidence: tools/advance_queue.py:58; tools/autonomy_tick.py:34; tools/autonomy_tick.py:36; tools/autonomy_tick.py:64; supplied dispatch durations and foreground cap.
layers.if_unfixed: One to three dispatches consume a foreground window, then another conversation must restart progress unless an effective supervisor resumes it.

layers.layer: FAR lacks a verified execution feedback loop
layers.claim: Decision rows and repeated diagnoses are not evidence that the stopping mechanism changed.
layers.mechanism: A DECIDE/DEFER/NO-ACTION entry does not itself re-arm a queue item, execute a repair, bind acceptance evidence, or enforce a subsequent transition.
layers.evidence: Supplied FAR/TT/queue/driver/tick inventory; tools/advance_queue.py:87 leaves re-arming to a human or later pass.
layers.if_unfixed: FAR generates more descriptions of the deadlock while the executable predicates remain unchanged.

layers.claim: The owner's completion condition cannot be satisfied by this agent alone.
layers.mechanism: Completion depends on externally issued admission, host IDs and a release seal, plus unresolved authority for a distinct checker principal; neither retries nor FAR confer those powers.
layers.evidence: Supplied completion requirements: three external signature requirements and two law gaps.
layers.if_unfixed: The agent either loops forever, stops without authorization, or falsely substitutes local evidence for external approval.

layers.layer: Exhaustion proof is not completion proof
layers.claim: Even a green continuation guard does not certify that both R15 command documents are complete.
layers.mechanism: Its successful output explicitly sets is_completion_claim=false and r15_2_complete=false; it proves queue exhaustion, not full contractual acceptance.
layers.if_unfixed: A future schema repair may turn the guard green without making the owner's completion condition true.

model_vs_structure.share: Approximately 25% model / 75% structure; diagnostic judgment, not a measured attribution.
model_vs_structure.why: Test a repaired reconciler and durable supervisor with all external inputs supplied: yielding with runnable work implicates the model. Replay today's state under another compliant model: READY-only selection and missing authority still prevent completion.

unsatisfiable_predicate.consequence: Unsatisfiable by the agent acting alone under current authority, not necessarily impossible for the whole organization. 'Never stop until complete' provides no achievable agent-only terminal state while external issuances and law gaps remain.
unsatisfiable_predicate.fix: Keep full completion strict. Obtain the external issuances and authoritative checker definition, or obtain an authorized contract amendment distinguishing COMPLETE from WAITING_EXTERNAL. The agent cannot authorize that amendment itself.

fixes.change: Define a validated satisfiable_by enum and retain explanatory prose separately; review and migrate each ambiguous row without guessing its authority.
fixes.risk: Misclassification can conceal real agent work or misassign authority.
fixes.makes_stop_impossible_because: Removes schema ambiguity as an excuse for inaction; does not independently enforce continuation.

fixes.change: Add reconciliation for PARTIAL, retryable PARKED, interrupted RUNNING and DONE_RECEIPT_RED items; generate bounded, idempotent next actions and re-arm only when dependencies permit.
fixes.risk: Blind retries can duplicate side effects; persistent failures need typed escalation rather than infinite retries.
fixes.makes_stop_impossible_because: READY exhaustion cannot count as actionable exhaustion until unresolved states have been reconciled.

fixes.change: Make the tick emit machine-readable progress, blocked and failure outcomes; have a durable supervisor resume checkpointed batches, recover expired execution leases and wait on dependency events.
fixes.risk: Overlapping workers and retry storms require exclusive leases, idempotency and backoff.
fixes.makes_stop_impossible_because: A foreground command or conversation ending no longer abandons outstanding runnable work; supervisor availability remains an operational requirement.

fixes.change: Bind actionable FAR decisions to queue transitions, mandated-lane execution receipts and behavioral acceptance tests; test recovery with PARTIAL-only work and across a forced turn boundary.
fixes.risk: Mechanical decision-to-task expansion can create duplicate or unauthorized work.
fixes.makes_stop_impossible_because: A FAR decision cannot be counted as an implemented repair until the relevant stopping failure is demonstrably prevented.

fixes.change: Issue evidence-bound requests for each external dependency and checker-law gap; secure authorized WAITING_EXTERNAL semantics without weakening full completion.
fixes.risk: Only the governing authority can change the contract; local substitutes must not impersonate native approval.
fixes.makes_stop_impossible_because: It does not prevent legitimate waiting; it makes unauthorized abandonment distinguishable from an explicitly authorized, resumable external wait.

fixes.change: Separate batch exhaustion, agent-actionable exhaustion and full completion; enforce each claim at the supervisor boundary using its actual evidence and both command-document acceptance sets.
fixes.risk: Renaming exhaustion to completion would launder missing acceptance; gates must remain fail-closed.
fixes.makes_stop_impossible_because: Routine batch completion cannot authorize round closure; only the corresponding verified terminal predicate can.

what_far_cannot_fix: FAR cannot mint external signatures, define missing authority, extend foreground runtime, or enforce execution merely by recording a decision. Those require authorized inputs and executable, tested control-plane changes.
legal_agent_terminal: COMPLETE iff every acceptance obligation in both R15 command documents has valid evidence, all required external issuances and checker authority are present, no unresolved agent-actionable work remains, and both mandated gates pass. WAITING_EXTERNAL is not COMPLETE and permits yielding only after explicit governing authorization, issued evidence-bound requests, exhaustion of legal agent work, and durable dependency-triggered resumption. Under the current standing order, external blockage alone does not authorize declaring completion. This read-only diagnosis implements no fixes or round-closure claim: mandate audit returned AUDIT_CLEAN; continuation_guard was not executed because its unconditional queue write at tools/continuation_guard.py:77 conflicts with read-only constraints. Its supplied NOT_TERMINAL result remains the operative evidence.
